$comment: What the A32 sheets show that LLVM's ARM TableGen and the unofficial Sail do not carry: sections, groups, formats, each row's mnemonic and assembly (a template starting with ~ glues its first part to the mnemonic: {s}{cond}), description and pseudocode, register names, in the decoder's order. sail names the Sail clause of a row when one LLVM record is two rows (LDRH's immediate and register forms), fix fixes a field (cpsie / cpsid), llvmFixed names LLVM operands covering bits the Sail writes as literals, excludeLLVM the LLVM records the sheet leaves out and why.

excludeLLVM.ADR: ADD / SUB (immediate) with rn = pc: the sheet lists those
excludeLLVM.MOVr_TC: a copy of MOVr for tail calls (same encoding)
excludeLLVM.TRAP: LLVM's name for one UDF value
excludeLLVM.MRSbanked: banked registers (Virtualization Extensions) not on the sheet yet
excludeLLVM.MSRbanked: banked registers (Virtualization Extensions) not on the sheet yet
